comment_th: Hello, I am contacting you again on behalf of several residents at Von Napa 54, as per our lawyer's request. Regarding the construction site next to our property, for over 10 months, SMC and the property owner have been working at all hours with complete disregard for the residents of Von Napa. This has made the apartments nearly unlivable. We have lodged numerous complaints, yet nothing has changed. The construction company continues to work at any time they please, including on holidays. It appears that both the property owner and the construction company believe they are above the law, with government authorities seemingly allowing them to operate under their own rules. This is particularly concerning given that the government department in question is funded by taxpayer money and is supposed to protect citizens, not the property owner or construction company. It looks extremely suspicious that they can operate however they want, without following the law, and face no consequences for their actions. After speaking with associates at SMC, they have confirmed that this is indeed the case and have been provided with evidence. As a final request before litigation begins, we would appreciate if the property owner, SMC, and a government representative could meet with the residents of Von Napa to explain why it seems impossible to enforce the law in this situation, and why the clearly outlined working hours are not being adhered to. We also request immediate action regarding the security lighting on the site. Since our initial complaint, the construction workers have deliberately pointed the security lights into our windows, making it impossible to sleep at night. The scaffolding remains unsafe and is leaning; it amazes us that this has not been ordered to be fixed, given health and safety standards. The forklift truck driver also frequently uses the horn without reason, seemingly to joke around and annoy the residents. We are not asking for much; we simply want the working hours that have been clearly outlined by your office to be observed. Several residents have CCTV footage capturing heavy and loud construction work starting at 6 AM and continuing until 11 PM lately. The audio also records conversations between the engineers and officials, where they openly joke about and dismiss our complaints. It is clear that this matter is not being taken seriously by anyone. We hope to hear from you soon. #TraffyWebsite #English

สะพาน หรือถนนส่วนบุคคลซึ่งเจ้าของยินยอมให้ประชาชนใช้เป็นทางสัญจรได้ ทางน้ำ หมายความว่า ทะเล ทะเลสาบ หาดทรายชายทะเลอ่างเก็บน้ า แม่น้ า ห้วย หนอง คลอง คันคลอง บึง คู ลำราง และหมายความรวมถึงท่อระบายน้ำด้วย อาคาร หมายความว่า ตึก บ้าน เรือน โรง ร้าน เรือ แพ ตลาด คลังสินค้า สำนักงาน หรือสิ่งปลูกสร้างอย่างอื่นซึ่งบุคคลอาจเข้าอยู่หรือเข้าใช้สอยได้และหมายความรวมถึงอัฒจันทร์
